remarks: BEAUTIFULLY RENOVATED WITH ACCESS TO ROOFTOP BALCONY W/ WATER VIEWS & WALKABLE TO TWO BEACHES! AVAILABLE NOW! Completely rebuilt and renovated top to bottom! No expense spared. Enjoy this spacious, turn-key FIRST FLOOR 2-Bedroom, 1-Bath apartment in sought-after Shippan just across from Cummings Park, Beach, & Yacht Club (with boardwalk, fishing pier, playground, fields, pickleball & tennis courts), and walkable to West Beach, shopping & restaurants. Beautiful hardwood floors, white trim, high ceilings, recessed lighting, and stylish finishes throughout. Brand new kitchen with quartz counters and stainless steel appliances, and brand new full bathroom with tiled shower, new vanity, and extra storage. Enjoy lovely views of the park across the street from the spacious covered front porch. Dedicated storage locker and washer dryer in the shared basement (access in rear of building). BRAND NEW CENTRAL AIR AND EFFICIENT GAS HEATING = LOW UTILITY BILLS! 1 dedicated off street parking space and addt'l/guest parking first come first serve (ask about option for second reserved parking space, if desired). First month rent plus two month security due at lease signing. ASK FOR LINK TO 3D TOUR! Pets considered on a case by case basis only. Must submit full rental application with credit/background/eviction check and proof of income for consideration. Driveway will be re-paved & washer/dryers will be installed prior to occupancy.
